"). In this context, the Ad-hoc Group has informed the Company that it agrees to a further extension of the standstill agreement concluded with the Company until 28 December 2026 and will not take or support any enforcement actions, in particular no termination of the Bond, in the event that the Company fails to make the interest payment (“
”) and the repayment of the principal amount of the Bond (“
”), each due on 28 November 2026. The terms and conditions of the Bond are furthermore to be amended to reflect this extension of the term.

Against this background, the Company has today decided to postpone the Interest Payment and the Repayment of the Bond to preserve the Company's liquidity and to enable the implementation of the restructuring concept agreed with the Ad-hoc Group.
The Company will inform the capital market and the public about the ongoing negotiations with the Ad-hoc Group and the further developments in accordance with statutory provisions.
This announcement is an ad hoc announcement pursuant to Article 17 of the Market Abuse Regulation (MAR) (Regulation (EU) No 596/2014).
